def select_next_node(current_node: int, depot: int, unvisited_nodes: np.ndarray,
                     rest_capacity: float, demands: np.ndarray,
                     distance_matrix: np.ndarray) -> int:
    if unvisited_nodes.size == 0:
        return 0
    cur = distance_matrix[current_node][unvisited_nodes]
    dep = distance_matrix[depot][unvisited_nodes]
    base = cur - 0.6 * dep

    n = base.size
    if n == 1:
        return int(unvisited_nodes[0])

    # Scale-free near-tie gate based on span of base scores
    span = float(np.max(base) - np.min(base))
    band = 1e-3 * span + 1e-12

    order = np.argsort(base)
    best = base[order[0]]
    # Determine near-tie set (all within relative band of best)
    threshold = best + band
    near_mask = base <= threshold
    if np.count_nonzero(near_mask) <= 1:
        return int(unvisited_nodes[order[0]])

    near_idx = np.nonzero(near_mask)[0]
    # Capacity-fit refinement: prefer largest demand that still fits,
    # i.e. minimize remaining slack after serving.
    dem = demands[unvisited_nodes[near_idx]]
    # Prefer larger demand (tighter packing), break ties by distance
    fit_slack = rest_capacity - dem
    # Score: minimize slack (maximize demand used), tie-break by base distance
    # Use base value scaled small so demand dominates subtly
    score = fit_slack * 1e-9 + base[near_idx]
    chosen = near_idx[int(np.argmin(score))]
    return int(unvisited_nodes[chosen])
